basic_profile.bio: Avid Destiny 2 player and a self-proclaimed Hunter main. Hailing from Portland, Oregon, I enjoy dissecting game mechanics and strategizing with my clan. When I'm not gaming, I'm a part-time barista and a full-time student majoring in Environmental Science. I'm deeply passionate about animal welfare and enjoy hiking with my dog on weekends. Typically online during late evenings and weekends, I balance my time between gaming, studying, and moderating a local environmental advocacy group. Single and enjoying the freedom to game and explore new hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Gained extensive knowledge in Destiny 2 through countless hours of gameplay and community interaction. Environmental Science major with a strong interest in sustainable living, acquired through academic studies and participation in local eco-projects.
